SELECT c.id AS creatorId,c.name AS creatorName,COALESCE(e.earned,0) AS earned,COALESCE(p.paid,0) AS paid,COALESCE(e.earned,0)-COALESCE(p.paid,0) AS balance FROM creator c LEFT JOIN (SELECT sl.creator_id,SUM(sl.amount) earned FROM settlement_line sl JOIN settlement s ON s.id=sl.settlement_id WHERE s.status='APPROVED' GROUP BY sl.creator_id) e ON e.creator_id=c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT creator_id,SUM(amount) paid FROM payment GROUP BY creator_id) p ON p.creator_id=c.id WHERE c.id=#{creatorId} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.net_amount),0) AS revenue,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.revenue_id IS NULL THEN r.net_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS unsettled FROM revenue r LEFT JOIN settlement_revenue sr ON sr.revenue_id=r.id JOIN platform_account a ON a.id=r.platform_account_id WHERE r.status='CONFIRMED' AND a.creator_id=#{creatorId}

SELECT month,SUM(revenue) AS revenue,SUM(cost) AS cost FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.revenue_date,'%Y-%m') month,SUM(r.net_amount) revenue,0 cost FROM revenue r JOIN platform_account a ON a.id=r.platform_account_id WHERE r.status='CONFIRMED' AND a.creator_id=#{creatorId} GROUP BY month UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.cost_date,'%Y-%m') month,0 revenue,SUM(c.amount) cost FROM project_cost c WHERE c.status='APPROVED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id=c.project_id AND pm.creator_id=#{creatorId}) GROUP BY month) monthly GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
